findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: portfolio_overview, search_stonewake_docs, screening_lookup, deal_book, company_records, developments, sanctions_person_candidates · Private data: portfolio_overview, portfolio_import_preview, tender_export_preview, search_companies, search_stonewake_docs, screening_lookup, deal_book, company_overview, company_financials, company_events, company_public_funding, company_network, company_records, sanctions_person_candidates · Public sink: portfolio_book, tender_export_preview, alert_deliveries · Destructive: search_stonewake_docs, screening_lookup, developments.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: portfolio_overview, search_stonewake_docs, screening_lookup, deal_book, company_records, developments, sanctions_person_candidates · Private data: portfolio_overview, portfolio_import_preview, tender_export_preview, search_companies, search_stonewake_docs, screening_lookup, deal_book, company_overview, company_financials, company_events, company_public_funding, company_network, company_records, sanctions_person_candidates · Public sink: portfolio_book, tender_export_preview, alert_deliveries · Destructive: search_stonewake_docs, screening_lookup, developments

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
